value.rationale: The sharp phase boundary separates a nontrivial interval of isometric-dilation-compatible strict band multipliers below the Hilbert exponent from immediate obstruction above it, uniformly over all measure spaces with two nonzero bands. This answers a motivated quantitative case of the published general defect norm question and includes the nontrivial exact boundary, not a generic application or tiny parameter gain.
